review.notes:
ReFineID is a driver and signing app for the Finnish national identity card (FINEID). It requires physical hardware the review team is unlikely to have: a FINEID smart card and a USB CCID smart-card reader. On iPhone the card can also be read over NFC.

Without the card, the app launches to its status window and shows "Present your identity card to the reader". That is the intended no-hardware state, not an error. A short video of the full flow on real hardware can be provided on request.

The bundled CryptoTokenKit token extension is the card driver; it makes the card's certificates available system-wide (Safari, Mail), which is the product's purpose. No accounts, no login, no data collection. Privacy policy: https://www.refineid.fi/privacy-policy/

The full source is public at https://github.com/ReFineID/ReFineID-Apple, which can clarify how the app works.

en-US.subtitle: Your ID card, in Safari
en-US.promotionalText: Log in to services with your identity card and sign documents.

description.macos:
A reader for the Finnish identity card.

Insert your identity card into a USB smart-card reader and sign in to e-services directly in Safari with the certificate on your card. Drop a PDF on ReFineID to sign it with a qualified signature.

ReFineID is open source: github.com/ReFineID/ReFineID-Apple
description.ios:
ReFineID brings the Finnish identity card to iPhone and iPad.

Read your card with a USB-C smart-card reader, or wirelessly on iPhone, then sign in to e-services directly in Safari with the certificate on your card.

ReFineID is open source: github.com/ReFineID/ReFineID-Apple

fi.subtitle: Henkilökortti Safarissa
fi.promotionalText: Kirjaudu palveluihin henkilökortilla ja allekirjoita asiakirjoja.

description.macos:
Suomalaisen henkilökortin lukija.

Aseta henkilökortti USB-kortinlukijaan ja kirjaudu sähköisiin palveluihin suoraan Safarissa kortin varmenteella. Pudota PDF ReFineID:hen ja allekirjoita se hyväksytyllä sähköisellä allekirjoituksella.

ReFineID on avointa lähdekoodia: github.com/ReFineID/ReFineID-Apple

sv.subtitle: Identitetskort i Safari
sv.promotionalText: Logga in på tjänster med ditt identitetskort och underteckna dokument.

description.macos:
En läsare för det finländska identitetskortet.

Sätt identitetskortet i en USB-kortläsare och logga in på e-tjänster direkt i Safari med kortets certifikat. Släpp en PDF på ReFineID för att underteckna den med en kvalificerad elektronisk underskrift.

ReFineID är öppen källkod: github.com/ReFineID/ReFineID-Apple
